Urvashi and Jagadish Reunite for Thriller-Drama 'Room No. 9'

Actors Urvashi and Jagadish are reuniting for the upcoming thriller-drama film 'Room No. 9', marking their first collaboration in three decades. The film, directed by debutant Jay Mohan, is scheduled for release later this year. The poster for the movie has also been released.
